allow: Dotfiles Tools: running the repo's own commands (theme, mango -p, mmsg, tools/docs, tests/run, install.sh --check) in ~/dotfiles is routine local work.
soft_deny: Package Removal: removing packages with pacman, paru or yay (-R, -Rs, -Rns, with or without sudo).
Unit State Changes: systemctl or systemctl --user stop, disable, reenable, mask or unmask. disable/reenable on a unit linked from ~/dotfiles deletes the repo's linked unit file.
